items.html: Behold, three phases are found in the Mochin: one is the phase of the three cavities of the skull itself, and this skull becomes the phase of three vessels to receive within them the three Mochin. Two is the membranes that are within the aforementioned vessels. Three is the three Mochin themselves, which are within the membranes, and they are the phase of very refined flesh, unlike the rest of the flesh; indeed, they are refined, but they are not truly spiritual.
